findings.description: On LookupTimeout the handler does `return enrich(event, geo)` without `await`. enrich is now async, so enrich_one returns a coroutine object. gather puts it in the results, and sink(event) then calls to_json on a coroutine, which crashes or writes garbage. The retry never runs, and a second timeout is never raised, contrary to the docstring. It also emits a 'never awaited' warning.
findings.suggestion: Use `return await enrich(event, geo)` in the except block, so a second LookupTimeout propagates and aborts the run.
findings.title: Retry returns un-awaited coroutine instead of an Event

findings.description: `total = sum(1 for _ in lines)` iterates `lines` fully. The CLI passes a file object, which is a one-shot iterator and is now exhausted. The following `for line in lines` reads nothing, so no events are processed. The output is empty, stats.read is 0, and progress shows 0/total. Any generator input behaves the same way.
findings.suggestion: Do not pre-count the input. Report progress by bytes read, or materialize the lines into a list first (memory cost), or have the caller seek the file back to the start.
findings.title: Input iterable consumed to count total, so the processing loop sees nothing
